title: How can I speak English more fluently? Ask BBC Learning English
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】我怎麼才能說得更流利？詢問 BBC 學習英語（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: How can you speak English more fluently?
cues.en: How can you speak English more fluently?
cues.zh: 怎樣才能說得更流利呢？

cues.text: Here's a question from Mary.
cues.en: Here's a question from Mary.

cues.text: That was Mary's question.
cues.en: That was Mary's question.

cues.text: But we also want your questions.
cues.en: But we also want your questions.
cues.zh: 但我們也希望您提出問題。

cues.text: You can send us a question to learningenglish@bbc.co.uk.
cues.en: You can send us a question to learningenglish@bbc.co.uk.

cues.text: But now, on to speaking fluency.
cues.en: But now, on to speaking fluency.
cues.zh: 但現在，我們要談談口語的流利程度。

cues.text: Let's go. So what does 'fluently' mean?
cues.en: Let's go. So what does 'fluently' mean?
cues.zh: 我們走吧。那麼「流暢」是什麼意思呢？

cues.text: Well, if you can speak fluently, you can speak easily without many pauses.
cues.en: Well, if you can speak fluently, you can speak easily without many pauses.
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你能流利地說，你就可以輕鬆地說，沒有很多停頓。

cues.text: So let's look at five ways you can speak English more fluently.
cues.en: So let's look at five ways you can speak English more fluently.
cues.zh: 讓我們看看可以更流利地說英語的五種方法。

cues.text: Learn informal expressions and practise using them.
cues.en: Learn informal expressions and practise using them.
cues.zh: 學習非正式表達並練習使用它們。

cues.text: For example, you could make a target of learning five a month.
cues.en: For example, you could make a target of learning five a month.
cues.zh: 例如，您可以設定每月學習五個的目標。

cues.text: It's really raining.
cues.en: It's really raining.

cues.text: No, it's chucking it down.
cues.en: No, it's chucking it down.

cues.text: How are you?
cues.en: How are you?

cues.text: How's it going?
cues.en: How's it going?

cues.text: How's it going?
cues.en: How's it going?

cues.text: How's it going?
cues.en: How's it going?

cues.text: Hey, how's it going?
cues.en: Hey, how's it going?

cues.text: Use words like 'actually' and 'basically'. They give you more time to think and
cues.en: Use words like 'actually' and 'basically'. They give you more time to think and
cues.zh: 使用“實際上”和“基本上”等詞語。他們給你更多的時間思考和

cues.text: they'll make you sound more fluent.
cues.en: they'll make you sound more fluent.
cues.zh: 它們會讓你聽起來更流利。

cues.text: Basically, I don't want to go out while it's raining.
cues.en: Basically, I don't want to go out while it's raining.
cues.zh: 基本上，下雨天我不想出去。

cues.text: Actually, I'll just go. Yeah. Bye.
cues.en: Actually, I'll just go. Yeah. Bye.
cues.zh: 其實我就走吧是的。再見。

cues.text: Fluent speakers of English use the /ə/ sound a lot.
cues.en: Fluent speakers of English use the /ə/ sound a lot.
cues.zh: 說流利英語的人常使用 /ə/ 音。

cues.text: We call it 'schwa', and we also use linking to connect words together.
cues.en: We call it 'schwa', and we also use linking to connect words together.
cues.zh: 我們稱之為“schwa”，我們也使用連結將單字連線在一起。

cues.text: Like this: A cup of tea.
cues.en: Like this: A cup of tea.

cues.text: A cup of tea.
cues.en: A cup of tea.

cues.text: A cup of tea. A cup of tea.
cues.en: A cup of tea. A cup of tea.

cues.text: That is a good cup of tea.
cues.en: That is a good cup of tea.

cues.text: How are you?
cues.en: How are you?

cues.text: How are you?
cues.en: How are you?

cues.text: How are you?
cues.en: How are you?

cues.text: how /ə/, how /ə/.
cues.en: how /ə/, how /ə/.

cues.text: How are you? How are you?
cues.en: How are you? How are you?

cues.text: Practice everywhere.
cues.en: Practice everywhere.

cues.text: Talk to people around you.
cues.en: Talk to people around you.

cues.text: Sian, if you could have any superpower, what would it be?
cues.en: Sian, if you could have any superpower, what would it be?
cues.zh: 西安，如果你能擁有一種超能力，你會是什麼？

cues.text: Ah, that's a good question.
cues.en: Ah, that's a good question.

cues.text: Or even talk to yourself while you're at home.
cues.en: Or even talk to yourself while you're at home.
cues.zh: 或甚至在家時自言自語。

cues.text: What are you doing?
cues.en: What are you doing?

cues.text: You can also talk to yourself or other people on the phone.
cues.en: You can also talk to yourself or other people on the phone.
cues.zh: 您也可以透過電話與自己或其他人交談。

cues.text: So I'm washing up.
cues.en: So I'm washing up.

cues.text: Uh, this is a mug because I just had a coffee, but I have to wash a saucepan,
cues.en: Uh, this is a mug because I just had a coffee, but I have to wash a saucepan,
cues.zh: 呃，這是一個杯子，因為我剛剛喝了一杯咖啡，但我必須洗一個平底鍋，

cues.text: a wooden spoon.
cues.en: a wooden spoon.

cues.text: I have loads of washing up, and I'm talking to myself to practise my English.
cues.en: I have loads of washing up, and I'm talking to myself to practise my English.
cues.zh: 我要洗很多東西，我正在自言自語地練習英文。

cues.text: Use words like 'so', 'well', 'erm'. English speakers use these all the time,
cues.en: Use words like 'so', 'well', 'erm'. English speakers use these all the time,
cues.zh: 使用「所以」、「好」、「呃」等字眼。說英語的人一直用這些，

cues.text: and they give you more time to think.
cues.en: and they give you more time to think.
cues.zh: 他們給你更多的時間思考。

cues.text: Erm, I dunno, well, we could go to the park.
cues.en: Erm, I dunno, well, we could go to the park.
cues.zh: 嗯，我不知道，好吧，我們可以去公園。

cues.text: Yeah. So, we just went to the park.
cues.en: Yeah. So, we just went to the park.
cues.zh: 是的。所以，我們就去了公園。

cues.text: Erm, well, no, it's really cold.
cues.en: Erm, well, no, it's really cold.

cues.text: It's raining. Actually, it's chucking it down.
cues.en: It's raining. Actually, it's chucking it down.
cues.zh: 下雨了。事實上，它正在把它放下。

cues.text: That's all for now but check below for more on this topic. See you soon.
cues.en: That's all for now but check below for more on this topic. See you soon.
cues.zh: 這就是現在的全部內容，但請檢視下面有關此主題的更多資訊。再見。
